ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Suspicious Browser Launch From Document Reader Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a browser process or browser tab is launched from an application that handles document files such as Adobe, Microsoft Office, etc. And connects to a web application over http(s), this could indicate a possible phishing attempt.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*Acrobat\\ Reader.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\ Office.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*PDF\\ Reader.*")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\maxthon\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\seamonkey\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*"))
